title: Hinomori Shiho — The First Notes〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Alright, now that we got what we came for, let's head home.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
(Hey, the used section...
They have so many instruments on display here.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
(Those look like electric basses.
And they come in different sizes and styles...)

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: I'll lend you my bass, so why don't you try getting a feel for it.

rows.Speaker: Sumire
rows.Line: Okay, if you move your fingers in the order I just showed you, then you should be able to play this riff now. Give it a try for me.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (I wish I had my own bass...)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
Sorry I took so long, Shiho.
You said you wanted to talk to me about something?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
So...
I have a really big favor to ask...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: After talking to Sumire and seeing her band perform... I decided that I wanna play the bass too.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: But I don't have enough allowance money saved up...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: This can come out of whatever allowance money and stuff I was gonna get in the future. I promise to pay you back once I'm allowed to get a part-time job.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: I know it's going to take me forever, but...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Then, why don't you try playing this one?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
An electric bass...
You had one ready?

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Yeah. After hearing what happened at the live house, I had a feeling you'd ask me for one.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line:
It's your bass.
Play whatever you like.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (Then, I'll try doing what I did the other day... How do I do this again...?)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (Something about letting the strings roll off my fingers... Don't just yank them...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (That didn't sound very good at all, but...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks, Dad...
I promise to practice really hard with it.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line:
(I'm gonna practice lots and lots.
And someday...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm gonna learn to put on shows that move people's hearts! Just like her!)
